title: VexClock
description: A lightweight client-side HUD mod for Minecraft Fabric 1.21.11 that displays the current world time.
body:
# VexClock

VexClock is a lightweight Fabric HUD mod that displays the current Minecraft world time directly on your screen.

Designed with a clean and minimal style, the clock shows only the information you need without backgrounds, borders, or unnecessary interface elements.

---

## Features

* Lightweight client-side HUD
* Displays the current in-game time
* Clean and minimal design
* Fully transparent background
* Movable HUD
* Automatic settings saving
* Optimized for maximum performance

---

## Customization

Customize the clock to match your preferences:

* Toggle the HUD on or off
* Switch between **24-hour** and **12-hour** formats
* Show or hide the day/night icon
* Enable or disable text shadow
* Change the text color
* Move the clock anywhere on the screen

All settings are saved automatically.

---

## Default Hotkeys

**O** — Toggle the clock

**P** — Open the position editor

The position editor lets you drag the clock anywhere on your screen while keeping the game world visible through a fully transparent background.

---

## Performance

VexClock is designed to have virtually no impact on game performance.

Performance optimizations include:

* Zero object allocations during rendering
* Cached time strings that update only when the displayed minute changes
* Automatic rendering pause when the HUD is hidden
* Automatic rendering pause while the F3 debug screen is open

---

## Compatibility

* Minecraft **1.21.11**
* Fabric Loader
* Client-side
* Singleplayer
* Multiplayer

---

## Requirements

* Fabric API

No additional libraries or configuration mods are required.

---
